intro: Our list of ACTIVE Notices to Nautical Inspectors can be found below.

notices.title: Updated AFSI Form Available
notices.text: The AFSI form has been updated and may be downloaded from Inspection Templates. The form is an Excel Worksheet and maintains the familiar MS Office look and feel in common with other Flag States.
notices.check: the "Inspection Templates" button is ours; the live text names the page without linking it

notices.title: Bulletin 341: MLC/DMLC Change of Policy
notices.text: In a change of policy, Barbados approved inspectors may no longer authorise DMLC Part II documents on our behalf and that it must be left solely to Class.
